name: Voice Note
description: A hold-to-record voice note: the pill opens into a live wave, sliding right throws the take away, and what you keep becomes a clip with a scrubbable wave.
interactionNotes: Press and hold the pill to record: it widens into a bar, the timer runs and the level draws itself as bars, the newest at the inline-end of the wave. Slide right while holding and the row travels with the pointer; past the throw distance the mark beside the timer turns into a red cross and the label under the pill asks you to let go, which discards the take. Releasing before that turns the take into a clip: a filled play disc, the wave and the duration, with a discard cross at the far end. Playing lights the bars as the playhead passes them and dragging across the wave scrubs. The level is a stand-in shaped like speech, so nothing ever asks for a microphone. With the pill focused, Space or Enter records while held and Escape throws the take away. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the pill widens without the overshoot and the play mark changes instantly.

props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars the wave is drawn with, clamped to 12 to 48.

props.name: gain
props.description: How tall a level draws, 0 to 100; at 0 the wave flattens to dots.

props.name: bounce
props.description: How far the pill overshoots the width it opens and closes to, 0 to 100; 0 widens without a bounce.

props.name: corner
props.description: Corner radius, px. The default is half the height, a full pill; the play disc follows the same curve.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Label, icons and the play disc, and the colour the pill's edge is mixed from.

props.name: waveColor
props.description: The bars while recording and the recorded ones in the clip.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: The recording dot, and the mark once the take is armed for the throw.

tips: The level is a stand-in shaped like speech, so the component never asks for a microphone; swap it for a real recorder when the audio has to exist.
A take shorter than 500ms is treated as a tap and dropped, and a recording stops itself at 30 seconds.
Sliding back before letting go disarms the throw, so the same take is kept instead of discarded.
The wave is `direction: ltr` on purpose: the time axis reads left to right as it does in every player, while the row around it stays right to left.
`corner` above 28 is clamped to half the height; at 0 the pill squares off and the play disc squares with it.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the width change and the play mark are instant.
